spec.title: SSHadowForge / Event Pipeline
spec.description: Each stage of the event pipeline: the gateway admitting commands, the bus, the projector and notifier consuming, the dispatcher merging and requesting builds, the workflow scheduling them. Includes the seal refusals and the dispatcher's per-step timings that say where its time goes.

spec.title: Projector backlog
spec.description: Events on the bus the projector has not applied yet (its own view of its durable).

spec.title: Projector idle
spec.description: Seconds since the projector last completed work. Only a stall WITH a backlog is a problem (SshadowforgeProjectorStalled).

spec.title: Commands p95
spec.description: Time to admit one command: introspection, the Keto check, the Vault seal and the publish. Measured baseline p99 ~0.66 s.

spec.title: Dispatcher p95 per event
spec.description: One approval or disposition, end to end. Everything behind it waits this long.

spec.title: Refused events (1h)
spec.description: Events the consumers refused: no valid gateway seal, a bad signature or a contract violation.

spec.title: Workflow requests refused (1h)
spec.description: Build requests the workflow refused or could not parse.

spec.title: Requests by route
spec.description: Route PATTERNS (bounded cardinality), never raw paths.

spec.title: Authz latency p95
spec.description: Hydra introspection and Keto checks, per gateway request (baseline p99 ~75 ms).

spec.title: Commands by kind and result
spec.description: What is being submitted and what became of it.

spec.title: Pending by durable
spec.description: Messages each durable has yet to receive.

spec.title: Ack pending by durable
spec.description: Delivered, not yet acknowledged. With MaxAckPending 1 this is 0 or 1; 1 for long is a wedge.

spec.title: Deliveries by durable
spec.description: Messages delivered per second (the delivered sequence advancing).

spec.title: Projection rate by outcome
spec.description: applied / skipped / transient (retried in place) / rejected (poison, terminated).

spec.title: Notifier outcomes
spec.description: consumed / notified / ignored / retried / abandoned / rejected (chat posts to chit-server).

spec.title: Stall clocks
spec.description: Seconds since each consumer last completed work. It grows on an idle forge; it matters only with a backlog.

spec.title: Dispatcher step p95
spec.description: Where one event's time goes. head_resolve (git ls-remote) is the measured tail.

spec.title: Dispatcher step time share
spec.description: Seconds per second spent in each step: the budget, not the latency.

spec.title: Merge decisions
spec.description: gated (a requirement unmet, usually the build), merged, stale_head, stale_base, conflict, not_fast_forward, already-merged, transient.

spec.title: Workflow scheduling
spec.description: builds_from_bus, builds_scheduled, deduped, refused; sweeps_*, challenges_*.
